grades.question: What are the rewards and reversibility at 2 and 4 Faction Influence, and does tying the Alliance holder at 4 steal the Alliance?
grades.expected: Reach 2 gets 1 VP lost below 2. Reach 4 gets track bonus retained if falling below, can earn again on re-reaching. First to 4 gets Alliance and its VP; tie does not steal, opponent must rise higher. Transfer loses old holder VP and gives new holder VP.

observed.answer: At 2 Influence, gain 1 VP; lose that VP if Influence falls below 2 and regain it upon reaching 2 again. At 4 Influence, gain the printed track bonus, which is retained if you fall below 4 and earned again upon returning to 4. The first player to 4 also gains the Alliance token and 1 VP; that VP follows possession of the token. Tying the Alliance holder at 4 does not steal it: an opponent must rise higher. If the holder loses Influence after being tied, the formerly tied player takes the Alliance; falling to 3 or lower also loses it, and if no one at 4+ can take it, it returns to the board.
observed.evidence: Victory Points, Faction Influence; FAQ & Rulings, Alliance loss: ‘Tying the current holder does not steal the Alliance’; the formerly tied player takes it if the holder loses Influence after being tied, and falling to 3 or lower loses it.

grades.reason: All requested thresholds, retained/repeated track bonus, first Alliance VP and higher-opponent transfer are present. VP follows possession of token is semantically equivalent to old-holder loss/new-holder gain; no literal phrasing requirement.
